what: The pill button sprouts from a single dot. At .2s the background dot goes 0→1 (sine.in). From .4s, over .3s, the width stretches from the dot to full width (quart.inOut). The arrow rises from the dot spot in .26s, slides to the right end from .46s, and at .76s the text pops in over .3s back.out. On hover it instantly swells to 1.15× and then settles to its size with a spring (tension 800, friction 30) over .6s, with the background one tone lighter

options.on: scroll (default — when it enters the screen) · load (right on attach) · manual (when an fx:show event is fired at the element) · none (doesn’t reveal, visible from the start, hover only)
options.tension · friction: Spring tension · friction, default 800 · 30 (same RK4 as Velocity 1.x)
options.area: Ancestor selector for measuring interaction — swells even when hovering the whole badge wrapping the button
options.--fx-bg · --fx-bg-hover · --fx-bg-inner: Skin (variable). With two background layers, the second is the inner panel

use: Your button text here
note: The original uses Velocity 1.3 same-element queues, so dot→stretch and arrow rise→slide follow one after another. The spring is rewritten with the same formula as Velocity’s generateSpringRK4.
